sources.title: UBERBOND Decision Engine
anchors: This is the canonical human-readable decision policy for UBERBOND.
Optimization is **lexicographic**, not a single weighted maximization.
A graph prior such as `SUSCEPTIBLE_TO` can determine what to inspect. It can never, by itself, create a finding, recommendation, outreach claim, or price.
A stage MUST fail closed when a critical input, authority, identity, policy, or calculation is unresolved.
